title: Bhoot Returns
desc: Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with Taman and Nimmi, their son and daughter respectively. However, strange occurrences start taking place and they must escape in order to survive.

title: Tommy - The Lovely Dog
desc: An academic welcomes a canine companion into his household. Meanwhile, the loyal animal provides critical support to the kin during a major life transition.

title: Shiva The Super Hero 3
desc: A group of three young friends decides to invest in a resort. However, things become complicated when they realise that it is haunted and take the help of a mentalist to track down the ghost.

title: Players
desc: A master thief stumbles upon a secret lead about a shipment of gold ingots being transported from Russia to Romania. Eventually, he recruits a gang of sly criminals to stage a daring heist.

title: Daring Policewala
desc: Police constable Mathimaran investigates illegal organ donations and tries to put an end to the suffering of innocent people.

title: Deep Sea Mutant Snake
desc: Deeply concerned about his fiancée's safety during her probe into Cass Corporation, Qin Yu seeks justice following her tragic demise. Concurrently, he challenges this immense firm.

title: Detective Shivaji
desc: Shivaji, a policeman, sets out to investigate a high-profile murder of a minister's son. However, while pursuing the leads, he must also deal with his internal conflicts.
